observations.behavior: Adds Azure Artifact Signing configuration and credential retrieval for Windows builds.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to sign Windows desktop builds with Azure Artifact Signing, which is required for the Windows desktop app to receive updates. The configuration includes the Azure signing account and certificate profile, which are used to sign the Windows executable. This is a prerequisite for the Windows desktop app to receive updates.
